experiment.policy: Unchanged consequence_runtime.mjs --economy-only fixture policy and all existing assertions; prescribed provider/person inputs, temporary local files, no paid inference. Cross-variant compare semantic traces, result/memory, file hash and effect counts.
experiment.method: Fresh kernel admission/instance per invocation as used by the existing fixture. Instrument cumulative fresh-call time and whole scenario time separately. First process per format is functional qualification, not acceptance timing. Then 3 rotating processes/format/window, two windows; raw per-process scenario timings retained.
experiment.limits: Both authenticated default kernels reserve input64KiB/working1MiB/output64KiB/stack64KiB and have a 256MiB physical ceiling. Candidate applies the same ceiling as logical limits. Fixed kernel/image sizes and setup costs are reported separately; all scenario file and mock-provider work remains in whole-scenario time.

nativeReplay.method: Three warmups and nine complete native invocations per captured command/process. Every output SHA-256 must match the corresponding captured WASM bytes. Three rotating processes/format/window, two windows. These selected steps do not establish a complete conversation timing.

localPoolExperiment.source: Boundary pool-buffers candidate, not yet in the authenticated published pair
localPoolExperiment.qualification: Native diagnostics only; do not attribute the published-pair macro timings to this later change.

baselineArtifacts.qualification: Prepared comparison artifacts. Emission/transcoding timings are not acceptance data; runtime comparisons have not run.

verdict: Published-pair document clarification has no repeatable overall improvement over BPC1, and clarify-first fresh-call totals regress about 24-28%. Native selected value-heavy steps improve while other steps and working allocation regress. Performance acceptance remains open.

reproduction.command: node tools/agent4/benchmark-clarification.mjs AGENT_SOURCE WORLD_RUNTIME IMAGE NEW_OUTPUT [--capture]
reproduction.native: World test/v2/build_replay_bench.zig builds the explicit source-pair replay tool. Pass the expected output SHA-256 and stream a captured command to stdin.
